title: Effect of sports massage on performance and recovery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
claims: The review identified 29 eligible randomised studies recruiting 1,012 participants.
There was no evidence that massage improves measures of strength, jump, sprint, endurance or fatigue.
Massage was associated with small but statistically significant improvements in flexibility and delayed-onset muscle soreness.
DOMS improved by approximately 13%, with SMD 1.13 (95% CI 0.44 to 1.82; 311 participants; 10 studies; I² = 86%).
Sports massage is defined in the review as manual manipulation of muscles and soft tissue by a qualified professional, with the purpose of improving performance in or recovery from sport.

verification.note: 经 Europe PMC 全文 XML 读取 Results、亚组/Meta 分析与 Discussion 正文，非仅摘要。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“We identified 29 eligible studies recruiting 1012 participants”；另述 12 项 RCT 与 17 项随机交叉研究。
原文：“We found no evidence that massage improves measures of strength, jump, sprint, endurance or fatigue”。
原文：“massage was associated with small but statistically significant improvements in flexibility and DOMS”。注意原文同时报告异质性很高（DOMS 的 I²=86%），且敏感性分析显示结果受个别离群研究影响；claim 未提，但未强化结论。
原文：“a statistically significant 13% improvement in measures of DOMS after exercise, with high study heterogeneity (SMD 1.13, 95% CI 0.44 to 1.82; participants=311; studies=10; I2=86%)”，数字逐项一致。
原文定义：“we defined sports massage as manual manipulation of muscles and soft tissue by a qualified professional, with the purpose of improving performance in or recovery from sport.”
